reviewer.provenance: Agentic read-only review; no reliance on REVIEW.md findings for case judgments.

methodology: Loaded all six paired inputs as UTF-8 text and recorded SHA-256 of raw input bytes before judgment.

Recomputed line offsets and structural edition/section headers independently; checked every selector against the exact source slice. Text offsets use Python universal-newline normalization, matching segmenter-produced draft offsets.
Checked sourceText identity, selector bounds, header start, next structural boundary, headerLine, year/yearRaw, stable page/year/letter identity, and flags.
Reparsed header components independently with the ratified last-comma publisher/location rule; malformed delimiters and residues remain explicit.
Recomputed pageCount with an independent bounded pattern set; malformed or parenthesized notations were not silently promoted.
Applied confirm/correct/uncertain/escalate per case; no uncertainty was silently promoted.

disposition_legend.confirm: All checked values and selector semantics are source- and schema-consistent.
disposition_legend.correct: Block/identity/selector are usable, but deterministic field cleanup is required.
disposition_legend.uncertain: A source or model ambiguity remains visible and requires explicit adjudication.
disposition_legend.escalate: A structural/model discrepancy requires stronger independent judgment before acceptance.

notable_findings: 54-1960-a and 54-1964-a share one physical block and selector.
54-1965-a and 54-1965-b use ca. 1965 and need the open identifier policy.
56-2010-a contains malformed '463/1)p.' while pageCount is null.
Header-field repairs are required for 54-1981-c, 54-1981-d, 56-1952-a, 56-1978-a, and 56-1981-b.
